title: aedex
subtitle: Agent data exchange CLI
summary: Catalog-first data marketplace for agents. Discover, inspect, and run hundreds of data tools — one CLI, one balance.
body: aedex is the top product focus under Aegntic: a decentralized exchange CLI and gateway for agent-native data tools. Discover first, run second, bill once. Web console and gateway at aedex.ing.

title: Cognitive OS
subtitle: Agent operating system
summary: Cognitive Operating System — multi-harness agent policy, verification chains, and execution stack.
body: Cognitive OS is the living operating manual for multi-harness agents: complexity triage, verification chains, memory layers, and security circuit breakers.

title: Cognitive Operator
subtitle: Sovereign runtime thesis
summary: A single operator that persists, coordinates, and acts over time — not a chatbot session. Built on Cognitive OS primitives.
body:
The Cognitive Operator is the product thesis: one sovereign runtime that remembers, coordinates, and acts on behalf of a user or org over time.

It sits on Cognitive OS (policy + verification) and pairs with aedex for real data I/O. Read the full narrative at /cognitive-operator/.

title: CLDCDE
subtitle: Developer ecosystem
summary: Claude Code ecosystem hub — tools, patterns, and operator infrastructure for agentic development.
body: CLDCDE is the public surface for Claude Code ecosystem work: tooling, patterns, and operator infrastructure that make agentic development shippable. Live at cldcde.cc.

title: Prologue
subtitle: Memory library
summary: Universal MCP discovery and memory library — cut setup from hours to minutes.
body: Prologue is MCP discovery and memory infrastructure for agent stacks. Stop re-solving auth, discovery, and wiring every time a new agent surface comes online. Live at logue.pro.

title: clawREFORM
subtitle: Agent city
summary: Agent-city surface for coordination, reform patterns, and multi-agent operations.
body: clawREFORM explores multi-agent coordination as an urban metaphor — agents as operators in a shared city. Production surface at clawreform.com.

title: AE Audits
subtitle: Agent-native decision review
summary: Structured adversarial council for expensive decisions — available on request, not the primary offer.
body: AE Audits remains available as decision-grade review with multiple adversarial lenses. Primary product focus has moved to aedex; audits is offered selectively.

title: prompt.fail
subtitle: Prompt failure surface
summary: Public surface for prompt failure modes and agent edge cases.
body: prompt.fail documents failure modes in prompt and agent systems.
